0.4.0.zh:
支持中国大陆 2026/2027 工作日规则：跳过非工作日或顺延到工作日。
主列表、看板、日历与提醒记录分页查询，相邻页预加载。
Android 通知支持打开、完成和稍后；Windows 气泡点击打开提醒记录。
修复长历史重复任务推进与全天任务提醒时刻保留。
设置新增关于与更新：离线版本说明、手动检查更新及 Releases 入口。
Windows 缺少 WebView2 时提供微软安装引导，不自动下载或安装。
所有同步设备升级后再启用新的工作日规则。
0.4.0.en:
Chinese 2026/2027 workday rules can skip or postpone non-working dates.
Task lists, boards, calendar events and notification records use paging and prefetch.
Android notifications offer open, complete and snooze; Windows balloon clicks open notification records.
Fixes long recurrence histories and preserves reminder times for all-day tasks.
Settings now include offline release notes, explicit update checks and a Releases link.
Windows guides users to Microsoft's WebView2 installer when the runtime is missing; nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
Upgrade all sync devices before enabling the new workday rules.
